columns.name: RAG_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Autogenerated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: USE_CASE_ID
columns.description: The associated use case identifier.

columns.name: USE_CASE_PARTITION
columns.description: Partitioning key based on use case segmentation.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a document in its source system.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SOURCE
columns.description: The original source of the document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: The type of the document (e.g. application/pdf).

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TITLE
columns.description: The title heading of the document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CATEGORY
columns.description: The category the document is classified in.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LANGUAGE
columns.description: The language used in the document text.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE
columns.description: The type of entity associated with the document.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the entity associated with the document.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Parent ID for the current object.

columns.name: GRANDPARENT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Grand parent ID for the current object.

columns.name: ROOT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Root object ID for the current object.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TEXT
columns.description: The textual content of the document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PROPERTIES
columns.description: Additional properties of the document.

columns.name: FILTER_PROPERTIES
columns.description: Filter properties of the document to support search.

columns.name: RAG_DOCUMENT_METADATA
columns.description: Information related to processing of the document such as chunking strategy.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The current processing status of the document.

columns.name: STATUS_DETAILS
columns.description: Additional details about the status of the document.

columns.name: DELETION_DATE
columns.description: The date when a document is deleted and made unavailable to be searched on.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: The date when a document expires and should be processed for deletion.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
